question: Why did Esther fall at the king's feet weeping, even after Haman was dead?
options: She was afraid the king was angry with her
She wanted Mordecai to be made king
She begged him to put an end to Haman's evil plan against the Jews
explanation: Esther pleaded with the king, weeping at his feet, begging him to put an end to the evil plan of Haman the Agagite against the Jews.
